dedupe_keys.name: comreg gigabit and fttp broadband coverage and take up by cso geography ireland

description: ComReg publishes fibre-to-the-premises (FTTP) and gigabit broadband coverage and take-up statistics for Ireland as a public feature service on its Open Data Map Hub. Gigabit networks here include FTTP and DOCSIS 3.x cable. The statistics come from an analysis of gigabit network presence and take-up at unique premises (Eircode) level and are aggregated to Central Statistics Office geographies: small areas, electoral divisions, local electoral areas, counties and NUTS2 regions. Coverage counts premises passed by an FTTP or gigabit network, each premises once whatever the number of networks; take-up counts premises passed that have an active service. The service is updated quarterly with the Quarterly Key Data Report, and the hub also offers a CSO broadband coverage layer, county-level broadband statistics, story maps, and layers for the wholesale dedicated capacity (leased lines) decision. Coverage: Ireland. Format and access: ArcGIS feature services and web maps, free; broadband statistics under Creative Commons licence from ComReg, with boundaries from the CSO and Tailte Éireann. Caveats: aggregated values do not show availability at individual premises; operator data underlie the counts. Simulation uses: small-area exposure of premises to fibre network failures, and planning of resilient connectivity. Related records: the ComReg Quarterly Key Data Report gives market statistics, and Ofcom Connected Nations is the neighbouring United Kingdom dataset.
